    SELECT "XCL_034", "XCL_038", "XCL_039", "XCL_041"
    FROM drivers
    WHERE "XCL_041" IN ('French', 'Japanese')
      AND "XCL_040" BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1990-12-31'
),
best_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        d."XCL_034" AS driver_id,
        d."XCL_038" AS forename,
        d."XCL_039" AS surname,
        d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
        MIN(lt."XCL_048") AS best_lap_ms
    FROM eligible_drivers d
    INNER JOIN lapTimes lt ON d."XCL_034" = lt."XCL_044"
    WHERE lt."XCL_048" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d."XCL_034"
)
SELECT 
    bl.forename,
    bl.surname,
    bl.nationality
FROM best_laps bl
ORDER BY bl.best_lap_ms ASC
LIMIT 5
